metaData.originalTitle: Built for broad benefit: our plan
metaData.title: Built for broad benefit: our plan
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI outlines its third-phase vision for AGI: building an automated AI researcher, accelerating the economy, and giving everyone a personal AGI, grounded in the principle of broadly distributing power and benefits.
metaData.summary: This article by Sam Altman and Jakub Pachocki announces OpenAI's entry into its third phase, shifting from research and product deployment to making advanced AI abundant, affordable, safe, and useful for everyone. It draws a historical parallel to the electrification of rural America to argue that transformative technologies deliver their deepest impact when access is widespread. The authors commit to building AI in service of humanity, emphasizing that power should be broadly distributed rather than concentrated among a few companies or governments. They outline three main goals: building an automated AI researcher (with an internal belief that by March 2028 a significant fraction of research will be done by AI systems), accelerating the economy, and giving every person on Earth a personal AGI. The piece also addresses risks, calling for international coordination on safety standards and arguing that human judgment, values, and public oversight become more important as AI capabilities advance. It explicitly rejects a future of total automation, stating that AI should augment human agency, not replace it.

mainPoints.point: OpenAI is entering its third phase, focused on making AGI abundant, affordable, and safe for everyone.
mainPoints.explanation: After research (phase 1) and product deployment (phase 2), the new phase aims to turn frontier capability into broadly accessible tools that people and organizations can use to thrive.

mainPoints.point: The core principle is distributing power and benefits widely, not concentrating them.
mainPoints.explanation: Drawing a historical analogy to electricity, the authors argue that transformative technologies have the deepest impact when access is widespread, and that concentrated power creates fragility.

mainPoints.point: Human judgment and public oversight become more critical as AI capabilities advance.
mainPoints.explanation: The article explicitly rejects total automation, stating that AI should augment human agency. A key long-term role for people will be deciding what is worth doing.

mainPoints.point: OpenAI plans to build an automated AI researcher by 2028.
mainPoints.explanation: The company believes AI systems will soon accelerate the research process itself, which is necessary for making fast progress on alignment, but this requires careful human steering and accountability.

mainPoints.point: International coordination on safety standards is essential.
mainPoints.explanation: The authors call for a global organization to coordinate leading AI efforts, reduce catastrophic risk, and enable coordinated action, including slowing frontier development when needed.

keyQuotes: Entirely automating everything is not the future we want. It would be unfulfilling, and it would be dangerous.
A key long-term role for people will be deciding what is worth doing.
Human history shows that concentrated power creates fragility, while widely shared power makes societies more resilient, adaptable, and free.
The first promise of electricity was practical, but its deeper impact came from the new possibilities it opened as more people could use it.

relatedArticles.title: Sam Altman + Greg Brockman - On The Great OpenAI Reset
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Sam Altman and Greg Brockman discuss OpenAI's journey, the shift towards personal AGI and agent infrastructure, the jagged frontier of AI capabilities, and the societal implications of abundant compute and intelligence.

relatedArticles.title: Building a safe， effective sandbox to enable Codex on Windows
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details the engineering journey of building a custom sandbox for Codex on Windows, from an initial unelevated prototype using SIDs and write-restricted tokens to a final elevated design that leverages dedicated Windows users and firewall rules for robust network isolation.

relatedArticles.title: This is ChatGPT Images 2.0
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI has officially launched Images 2.0, a highly intelligent image generation model capable of 'thinking', web searching, generating complex diagrams, supporting multilingual prompts, and creating coherent multi-image sets for professional production.

relatedArticles.title: OpenAI Introduces GPT-Realtime-2 in the API
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI announces GPT-Realtime-2, its most intelligent voice model with GPT-5-class reasoning, alongside new streaming models for translation and transcription.

relatedArticles.title: Advancing voice intelligence with new models in the API
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI introduces three new audio models in the API—GPT-Realtime-2, GPT-Realtime-Translate, and GPT-Realtime-Whisper—to enable more intelligent, natural, and actionable real-time voice applications for developers.

relatedArticles.title: Introducing workspace agents in ChatGPT
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI introduces workspace agents, a new class of shared, long-running AI agents within ChatGPT for business teams, designed to automate complex workflows, integrate with organizational tools, and operate under enterprise-grade controls.

relatedArticles.title: Codex Now Integrates Directly with Chrome on macOS and Windows
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI introduces a new Chrome extension for Codex on macOS and Windows, enabling the AI to operate directly within a user's live browser session to perform complex, parallel automation tasks using their active profile and direct code execution.

relatedArticles.title: OpenAI Introduces GPT-5.5: A New Class of Intelligence for Agents
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI announces GPT-5.5, a new model designed for complex goal understanding and autonomous task completion, now available in ChatGPT and Codex.

relatedArticles.title: Codex for (almost) everything
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI announces a major update to Codex, expanding its capabilities beyond coding to include computer operation, web interaction, image generation, and deeper integration across the software development lifecycle with new features like memory, automations, and over 90 plugins.

relatedArticles.title: Introducing GPT-5.5
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5, its most capable model yet, with significant gains in agentic coding, knowledge work, and scientific research, while maintaining GPT-5.4 latency and improving token efficiency.
